mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO goods_sku_price_daily ( id, tenant_id, spu_id, sku_id, stat_date, sale_price, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), #{row.tenantId}, #{row.spuId}, #{row.skuId}, #{row.statDate}, #{row.salePrice}, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sale_price = VALUES(sale_price), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT sku_id AS skuId, MIN(sale_price) AS minPrice, COUNT(DISTINCT sale_price) AS priceKinds, MAX(CASE WHEN stat_date = #{today} THEN sale_price END) AS todayPrice FROM goods_sku_price_daily WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date >= #{startDate} AND sku_id IN #{skuId} GROUP BY sku_id
